structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a copycat "e/acc" token, 13 minutes old, trading around $64-70k market cap. The real e/acc meme coin (CbcyNo..., about $17.7M market cap, $600k liquidity, launched about 12 hours earlier) went up roughly 990x in 24 hours, according to news reports that describe it as based on Beff Jezos's e/acc movement and the UsePaid mechanism. This token's metadata links to a Beff Jezos X post (status 2103593870189858971, which I could not read: X returned HTTP 402). Its "website" is the UsePaid page of the real token. Its description is "from crime szn to merci szn". It opened with a burst of about 950 unique buyers in 15 minutes, reached an all-time high near $130k, then dropped 43% in the 5 minutes before detection. In the latest 5 minutes GeckoTerminal shows only about $2.8k volume and 63 buyers, so the burst is fading. Two other same-name copycats launched within seconds or hours of this one and are already near zero.

narrative.description: The story is spillover from the hot e/acc / Beff Jezos coin, which is at $17M after a 990x move. This token may be riding a new Beff tweet (the 'merci szn' line), but it adds no clearly new story of its own.
narrative.why_spreading: Beta plays on a hot same-ticker coin draw quick sniper and bot flow. The unique-buyer burst in the first 15 minutes fits bot or aggregator buying of a new e/acc pair better than organic discovery.
